plain_summary: Review INR monitoring when warfarin overlaps carbamazepine or carbamazepine is started or stopped during warfarin treatment.
rule_for_models: Review concurrent carbamazepine and warfarin, including starting or stopping carbamazepine during warfarin treatment. Ask about INR follow-up. Estimate treatment dates from supply dates, quantities and stated daily doses, allowing for documented dose changes. Cite both supplies and any dated start or stop during warfarin treatment. If unclear directions prevent dating a plausible overlap or treatment change, report only a possible finding. Ask when each medicine was taken, the current doses and when carbamazepine started or stopped. INR results and the clinic plan may be absent. For a documented interaction, retain the review and ask when INR was last checked and what follow-up is planned. Include a switch that stops carbamazepine during warfarin treatment. The indication does not change the check. Exclude a carbamazepine course that clearly ended before warfarin began.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review INR follow-up and the warfarin dose in light of concurrent carbamazepine or a recent start or stop during warfarin treatment?

needs_facts.meets: Follow-up context only. Cite a recorded result and date. If missing, retain the interaction review and ask when INR was last checked.
Follow-up context only. If the plan is absent, ask about the next INR check. Do not infer missed monitoring.
